mappings.note: digest algorithm is declared; current resource identity is blake3 and must not be compared as if it were the Q1 sha256 string
vertical top-to-bottom shaping is derived from writingMode while TextDirection retains bidi direction
vectors preserve order but do not enforce canonicalization; the producer must preserve feature order and sort axes by tag
rustybuzz offsets are folded into positions and advances remain explicit after font-unit scaling
schema supports ligatures and shared clusters; Q2 conversion must be direction-aware and must not assume one character per glyph
backend variation vertical and face-index rejection are capability policy rather than missing transport fields

canonicalizationRequirements: variation axes are unique and sorted by tag
negative zero is normalized before identity hashing
OpenTypeFeatureSetting enabled and value states map to one unambiguous u32 value
font size and synthetic style remain FontInstanceKey inputs even though Q1 rustybuzz font-unit oracle is size-independent
digest values are compared only with the declared algorithm

evidence: ShapingOutputDecision preserves typed disposition and reason in the standalone Q1 boundary

TextShapeReport is not retained by PageLayerTree JSON

rejectedPath.forbiddenShortcut: do not encode disposition only inside GlyphRunDiagnostics.reason because rejected requests have no GlyphRun

privacy: no font bytes duplication in diagnostics
